findings.description: Retrieval: https://www.ece.lsu.edu/fac/faculty-az-insert-fierce.js (brief.lists, primary) downloaded with curl -sS -L -m 90 at 2026-11-25T02:17:54Z (after brief.created_at 2026-11-25T02:17:28Z); 83,812 bytes; SHA-256 07ce39b8... (response_sha256 in sources).

Parse: the script is 392 page_html += string statements (plus the var declaration), decoded with a stdlib Python decoder into 72,956 characters of HTML. The table contains exactly 30 tr.fac-az-row entries, each with a name link, a div.nrank title and a fac-az-key-* filter class set. There are no section headings in the list; statuses come from the row's displayed rank.

Enumeration: all 30 displayed names match the brief's 30 required people exactly (after no normalization beyond whitespace), so there are no omissions and no list source failure. Expected_primary_profile_urls in the brief lists the URL without 'www.'; the exact brief.lists URL (with 'www.') was downloaded as instructed.

Profile pages: https://www.ece.lsu.edu/fac/gu.php, naraghi-pour.php and ajmera.php each returned HTTP 404 'File not found.' at 2026-11-25T02:18Z. They are not cited; no profile evidence was available for any person. Profile pages were not otherwise attempted.

Counts from displayed ranks: 20 professorial rows (regular, current; includes Gu and Naraghi-Pour), 2 Professor Emeritus (excluded, past: Ajmera, Czarnecki), 3 Instructor (teaching, excluded: Abdelwahab, Bonner, OLoughlin), 5 Instructor-Adjunct (adjunct, excluded: Duarte, McAnelly, Morell, Salehi, Stewart). Included total 20, of which none incoming (no start dates in the script).

Borderline: displayed rank is a professorial named chair, but the row carries the internal 'Emeriti' filter class. Decided regular/current by source_precedence (specific displayed appointment title over generic filter label). Outcome changes to excluded/past only if an official source states emeritus status.
